statement: Cemu 29f2f1f ARM64 AppImage, motionplus, with an external kernel MP holder, reads base EEPROM at 0x0016 successfully with the synthetic caller image. Native requests remain in extension identity/activation exchange, with mixed success and error 7 responses at offset 0xFA. No native extension calibration request is observed; shared kernel traffic limits actor attribution. Decoded application motion is unobserved. No defaults, physical calibration or radio acceptance is inferred.

applicability.revision: Original virtual model; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Bounded virtual UHID observation with caller-image choice explicit. No decoded application-state, physical, radio, game, timing or whole-controller acceptance promotion.
